clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau says a man with ADD once called him flunking calculus, convinced he just could not concentrate. He had a test the next day and 20 equations he could not hold in his head.

He learned one memory technique from lesson seven of Kevin's course, studied one night, and scored 100%. The teacher was so sure he cheated that she made him retake the exam in the principal's office. His only problem: he could not forget the equations even if he tried.

Comment "BRAIN" and I will send you the free training behind the technique he used.

#kevintrudeau #memory #studytips #focus #success #mindset
